name: Knowledge AI Bot
author: Calogero1975

sections.description:
Knowledge AI Bot is a powerful WordPress plugin that adds an intelligent AI chatbot to your website, specifically designed to help visitors understand and engage with your content. Unlike generic chatbots, Knowledge AI Bot focuses on your site’s actual content, making it the perfect solution for knowledge-based websites, documentation sites, educational platforms, and content-rich blogs.

🚀 Key Features

Multi-AI Platform Support
* OpenAI GPT-4 & GPT-4 Mini integration
* Claude Sonnet by Anthropic
* Google Gemini support
* Easy API configuration with connection testing

Smart Content Understanding
* Contextually aware responses based on your website content
* Helps visitors dive deeper into your articles and pages
* Reduces bounce rate by keeping users engaged
* Perfect for complex topics that need explanation

Fully Customizable Appearance
* Adjustable chatbot dimensions (width & height)
* Custom color schemes with gradient support
* 7 built-in professional icons + custom SVG support
* Flexible positioning (bottom-right or bottom-left)
* Personalized chat titles and branding

User-Friendly Experience
* Clean, modern interface with smooth animations
* Mobile-responsive design
* Real-time streaming responses
* Markdown support for rich text formatting
* Typing indicators and visual feedback

Developer & Admin Friendly
* Simple setup process
* Comprehensive admin panel
* Customizable system prompts
* Clean code architecture
* WordPress coding standards compliant

💡 Perfect For

  • Knowledge Base Sites: Help users understand complex documentation
  • Educational Websites: Explain concepts and answer student questions
  • Content Blogs: Engage readers with deeper explanations
  • Business Websites: Provide intelligent customer support
  • Documentation Sites: Make technical content more accessible

🎯 Why Choose Knowledge AI Bot?

Unlike generic chatbots that provide generic responses, Knowledge AI Bot is designed specifically for content-focused websites. It understands the context of your pages and provides relevant, helpful responses that encourage deeper engagement with your content.

Before Knowledge AI Bot:
* Visitors leave when they don’t understand something
* High bounce rates on complex content
* No way to provide instant explanations
* Users struggle with technical documentation

After Knowledge AI Bot:
* Interactive learning experience
* Increased time on site
* Better user comprehension
* Reduced support requests

🔒 Privacy & Security

  • All conversations are processed through secure API connections
  • No conversation data is stored locally
  • API keys are safely encrypted
  • GDPR and privacy compliance friendly
  • Custom SVG sanitization prevents XSS attacks

Support

Need help? Here’s how to get support:

  • Documentation: Visit our comprehensive documentation
  • Community: Join our community forum for tips and tricks
  • Premium Support: Get priority support with our premium plans

Credits

  • Built with ❤️ for the WordPress community
  • Uses secure API integrations with leading AI providers
  • Follows WordPress coding standards and best practices
  • Icon designs inspired by modern UI/UX principles

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party AI service APIs to provide intelligent chatbot functionality. When users interact with the chatbot, their messages along with the current page content are sent to the selected AI service to generate responses.

OpenAI API (api.openai.com)
* What it’s used for: Provides AI-powered responses using GPT-4 and GPT-4 Mini models
* Data sent: User messages, current page content, and conversation context when users interact with the chatbot
* When data is sent: Every time a user sends a message to the chatbot on your website
* OpenAI Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/row-terms-of-use/
* OpenAI Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/en-GB/policies/row-privacy-policy/

Anthropic Claude API (api.anthropic.com)
* What it’s used for: Provides AI-powered responses using Claude Sonnet models
* Data sent: User messages, current page content, and conversation context when users interact with the chatbot
* When data is sent: Every time a user sends a message to the chatbot on your website
* Anthropic Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/terms
* Anthropic Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy

Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com)
* What it’s used for: Provides AI-powered responses using Gemini Pro models
* Data sent: User messages, current page content, and conversation context when users interact with the chatbot
* When data is sent: Every time a user sends a message to the chatbot on your website
* Google Gemini API Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
* Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Important Privacy Information:
* Only one AI service is used at a time based on your plugin configuration
* No conversation data is stored locally on your WordPress site
* All data transmission occurs over secure HTTPS connections
* You must obtain API keys directly from each service provider
* Each service has its own data retention and privacy policies

Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Valid API key from supported AI service
  • HTTPS recommended for secure API communications

Transform your website visitors into engaged learners with Knowledge AI Bot!
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Knowledge AI Bot”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Knowledge AI Bot in your admin menu
  2. Choose your preferred AI service (OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini)
  3. Enter your API key
  4. Test the connection to ensure everything works
  5. Customize the appearance in the “Appearance Settings” section
  6. Save your settings

That’s it! Your AI chatbot will now appear on all your posts and pages.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, you’ll need an API key from one of the supported AI services:
* OpenAI: Get your key at https://platform.openai.com/
* Anthropic Claude: Get your key at https://console.anthropic.com/
* Google Gemini: Get your key at https://makersuite.google.com/

How much does it cost to run?

The plugin itself is free, but you’ll pay for API usage based on your chosen service’s pricing. Most sites with moderate traffic spend $5-20 per month.

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

Absolutely! You can customize:
* Colors and gradients
* Width and height
* Toggle button position
* Chat title
* Icon selection (7 built-in + custom SVG)

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! The chatbot is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices with touch-friendly interactions.

Can I control what the AI talks about?

Yes, you can set a custom system prompt in the settings to guide the AI’s responses and keep them focused on your content.

Is my data secure?

Yes, the plugin follows WordPress security best practices. API keys are stored securely, and no conversation data is retained on your server.

Does it slow down my website?

No, the plugin is optimized for performance. The chatbot loads asynchronously and only when needed.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

Yes, you can install it on as many sites as you want, but each site will need its own API configuration.
